families.author: Project
families.license: original arrangement and synthesis made for this project; the underlying melodies are in the public domain: Korobeiniki (Russian folk song (19th century)); Kalinka (Ivan Larionov, 1860); By the Long Road (Boris Fomin, 1924 (Dorogoi dlinnoyu)); God Save the Tsar! (Alexei Lvov, 1833); The Great Gate of Kiev (Modest Mussorgsky, Pictures at an Exhibition, 1874); Song of the Volga Boatmen (Russian folk song, published by Mily Balakirev in 1866); On the Hills of Manchuria (Ilya Shatrov, 1906)
